comparator.route: Natuur- en Sterrenkunde, ordinary 180-EC bachelor without optional advanced astronomy minor or dual degree
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted EER, Articles 7.3–7.5, prescribes 60 EC first-year courses, 69 EC compulsory second/third-year courses, 39 EC non-overlapping eligible elective space (which may include a 15–30 EC minor), and a 12-EC Bachelorstage Natuur- en Sterrenkunde final research project: 60+69+39+12=180. First-year physics/practical/data course NWI-NP017E is 9 EC, replacing the older 6-EC lab and 3-EC data components; the current route does not count both. The English Writing Skills in Academia is the first-listed allowed writing-course choice. The 30-EC Advanced Astronomy minor is optional and its old form closes to registration at the end of 2026–27; selecting it creates a specific 6-EC laboratory exemption and is therefore not silently added to the general route. The 225-EC Mathematics and Physics dual bachelor and transitional cohorts are separate. General 0-EC RADAr requirements are not counted in the 180 EC. The formally named route is the standard Dutch-taught single bachelor, even though individual courses may be in English.

programmes.label: Physics and Astronomy at Radboud University

exception.reason: The Radboud bachelor requires a sustained physics and astronomy spine: mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics, quantum theory, relativity, laboratory physics and a survey of the universe in year one, followed by advanced mechanics, electromagnetism, two quantum courses, statistical mechanics, atomic and solid-state physics, subatomic physics and two further laboratory courses. The 12-EC final project is research in the same field. UCR offers relevant mathematics and programming but no mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum physics, astrophysics, modern physics or experimental physics laboratory sequence. A 24-course mathematics/data/environmental-science schedule could be coherent on its own but would leave virtually all of this target’s defining discipline absent. Calling it a closest Physics and Astronomy comparison would mislead prospective students.
exception.curriculumContext: The current 2026–27 EER directly defines a coherent 180-EC single-bachelor pathway with 129 EC mandatory courses before electives and final project. This exception preserves the complete external course list and distinct optional elective structure rather than inventing a UCR physics programme.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Read all 151 current enriched UCR course rows with names, descriptions, outline-derived profiles, disciplines, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned Fall 2026–Spring 2029 availability. DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISMATH211 Linear Algebra, DISMATH214 Advanced Calculus, DISMATH314 Probability & Statistics, DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming, DISMATH213 Computational & Numerical Methods and DISDATA111 Introduction to Data Science can cover genuine mathematical/computational supports. ENSENVI111 Dynamic Earth, ENSSUST111 Climate Change and ENSENVI213 Earth System Science Tools treat physical environmental systems but do not teach mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, quantum theory, astronomy or physics laboratory methods. No UCR course sequence supplies the compulsory discipline needed to turn those supporting subjects into a 24-course physics-and-astronomy curriculum.
